title: Property Conversion Finance UK
h1: Property Conversion Finance UK (search-result title; H1 not confirmed by snippets)
summary: The /conversions/ page presents Silver Oak Capital's 'conversion finance': short-term (bridging-type) funding for projects where the use class of a building changes. Two routes are described: (1) commercial-to-residential conversions under permitted development rights and (2) residential title-splitting, turning one large house into several flats. Lenders size the loan on the post-conversion value: the page cites borrowing of up to 65-70% of gross development value (GDV), said to cover most construction costs. The page also mentions the creation of new leases for each unit. Only partial excerpts were surfaced; no verbatim page text, meta description, FAQ, fees, rates, durations or CTA wording were revealed. Related site pages (refurbishment, HMO, mixed-use, bridging) carry adjacent detail.
